content:
maya: Drafting the cross-post schedule for the benchmark narrative + launch teaser. Need final copy + 2 creative variants by EOD so we can queue X and LinkedIn.
raj: Can we aim for staggered posting? X at 11:00 PT, LinkedIn at 13:00 PT (gives time for X traction). Works for me.
maya: yup that staggers pickup. Also want a long-form thread for X (5 tweets) and a single long LinkedIn post with 3 images.
sloane: Image specs: X prefers 1200x675 for preview, LinkedIn 1200x627. Can we get square thumbnails for feed too? cc @olivia for creative.
olivia: On it — I'll upload 3 art variants to figma by 4pm. One variant is product screenshot, one is benchmark chart, one is customer quote card.
chris_g: For tracking: use utm_source=x, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=benchmark-launch. Also shorten with rbw.link/bench1 so we can swap landing A/B.
maya: thanks. Also we need two messaging hooks: technical (latency/cost numbers) and product (how teams ship features faster). Which do we push as lead copy?
raj: Lead with technical on X thread (numbers perform better there), product angle on LinkedIn. We can surface both in CTAs.
sloane: Thread length — keep first tweet a short hook, second tweet quick stat, third tweet chart image, fourth tweet customer quote, fifth CTA + link.
olivia: Drafting caption options now. Two CTAs: "See benchmark" and "Get reserved capacity".
chris_g: Suggest adding a note about model variants + rollouts in one line for the technical audience. e.g., "switch models without infra toil."
maya: Good. Can someone write the 5 X tweets in thread form? I can polish. @raj?
raj: I'll sketch them and drop in thread. ETA 1hr.
engagement-bot: Reminder set — queue review meeting at 16:30 PT if creatives land.
olivia: Uploaded Figma links: https://figma.com/file/abc123/bench-creatives — comments enabled.
sloane: Pls export the chart as PNG (high-res), include alt text: "Benchmark: tokens/sec vs cost per 1k tokens"
maya: Copy variants: pushing technical-first + product-first into the scheduling doc. Also drafting short DM template for follow-ups to people who comment (ask for demo or asset).
chris_g: DM template idea: "Thanks for the comment — would you like a quick look at our benchmark deck? Happy to send slides + schedule a 15-min walkthrough."
olivia: I'll prepare the influencer/tag list and a short outreach note for our partners.
raj: Once I post the X thread I'll monitor first 30 mins and amplify top replies. Who's on +1?
maya: I'll handle amplification. @sloane you on image refresh if we need quick edits?
sloane: Yep.
maya: Final ask — can we get captions localized for EMEA morning by tomorrow? If not, we'll use single English post.
olivia: I'll see about translations, but might need vendor help — will update.
maya: Great. Thanks team — expecting final queue by 17:30 PT.
engagement-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled for 1912347500 to check engagement metrics and DM follow-ups.
